HexKagune 1.0.16 for Forge 1.20.1 (clients need PlayerAnimator, bendy-lib and Photon). Install on client and server (protocol 37).

- **Peace is playable.** Four cross blades on chains: M1 combo Lance, Sweep, Scissor and Crucifix. Abilities: Z Crossblade Waltz, J Aegis of :Re (press again to open it), G White Wing Ascent (press again to dash, M1 to dive), B Piercing Salvation, C Rebirth Instinct, V The Final Horizon.
- **Peace's blades, reanimated:** smooth curved chains that never pass through the body, wind-up and recovery on every move, an angelic idle and pose, fewer particles. Shown in first person too.
